content: पीडा [पीड् भावे भिदा˚ अङ्] .²1 Pain, trouble, suffering, annoyance, molestation, agony; आश्रमपीडा <ls>R. 1. 37</ls> ‘disturbance’, 71; मदन˚, दारिद्र्य˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Injury, damage, harm; मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत् पीडया क्रियते तपः <ls>Bg. 17. 19</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 169</ls>. .²3 Devastation, laying waste. .²4 Violation, infringement. .²5 Restriction. .²6 Pity, compassion. .²7 Eclipse. .²8 A chaplet, garland for the head. .²9 The {%Saralā%} tree. .²10 A basket.
